name: Yield Optimizer USD
oneLiner: yoUSD is an ERC-4626 yield-aggregator on Base that rebalances USDC across 50+ whitelisted DeFi protocols, with NAV appreciating from accrued strategy yield.
collateral: USDC deposits continuously rebalanced across 50+ whitelisted DeFi yield sources on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and Unichain; allocations ranked by Exponential.fi risk-adjusted ratings with per-pool caps (max 50%) and per-protocol caps (max 70%); 5 smart contract audits by Offbeat Security, Hunter Security, Spearbit/Cantina, Aether Labs, and Paladin with no critical or high findings; admin multisig with <4 signers controls protocol whitelisting; backed by Paradigm, Haun Ventures, and Coinbase Ventures
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 vault on Base; USDC deposited via yoGateway, rebalanced cross-chain to whitelisted DeFi pools; NAV appreciates with accrued yield (e.g. ~$1.069 at launch anniversary); instant redemptions up to liquidity buffer, larger withdrawals up to 24h as cross-chain positions unwind

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yoUSD is a multi-chain yield-optimizer stable asset whose strategy allocates across protocols and chains. The workflow's L2BEAT route signal points to Across, so Pharos scores bridge-route exposure as a liquidity-or-intent route rather than native-only issuance.

reserveReview.rationale: YO documents yoUSD as a USDC-denominated ERC-4626 vault that rebalances across whitelisted DeFi pools using risk-adjusted allocation. The existing eight-slice registry envelope is retained unchanged and each slice is classified by its documented protocol or stablecoin exposure; changing live weights are not inferred from a static source.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: YO yoUSD underlying-asset and strategy-allocation disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reviewed envelope covers the recorded strategy categories, but current pool weights within the dynamic categories and legal custody safeguards are not fixed by the public documentation.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: YO identifies its vaults and whitelisted DeFi strategy venues but does not establish statutory segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or provider shares. Rehypothecation is marked permitted because the vault actively deploys deposits into lending and other DeFi strategies.

notices.title: Resolv-linked strategy loss
notices.message: yoUSD reported a roughly 2.95% drawdown after the March 22 2026 Resolv exploit impaired Resolv-linked exposure. Treat the NAV as strategy-risk-bearing, not a monotonic dollar claim. https://resolv.xyz/blog/resolv-postmortem-march-22-2026-incident

mintAuthority.summary: yoUSD is an ERC-4626 vault on Base where any user mints share tokens by depositing USDC; base asset issuance is inherited from Circle, while the privileged surface is a verified 4/6 Safe and authority contract controlling strategy/protocol whitelisting and rebalancing.

controls.label: yoUSD admin Safe
controls.evidence: Safe API confirmed Base Safe 4-of-6 (threshold 4, 6 owners, no modules, zero guard, fallbackHandler 0xfd07..., version 1.4.1+L2) at Base block 47201583. This Safe holds PROPOSER_ROLE on the 2-day TimelockController (0x38ce5e45d0f5d03e83863bb19b3b1a272c186f48) which owns the ProxyAdmin (0x12e81209d180ff0b3fbfbfe8fa9ffdb5990e1073) that controls the yoUSD vault upgrades.

controls.label: yoUSD authority contract
controls.evidence: Base authority review resolved this contract as the yoUSD authority layer owned by the 4/6 admin Safe; it controls privileged vault/strategy permissions rather than discretionary creation of underlying USDC.

controls.label: yoUSD ERC-4626 vault (share mint on deposit)
controls.evidence: Users deposit USDC via yoGateway and receive yoUSD vault shares at NAV; the vault contract performs ERC-4626 share accounting and does not create discretionary supply.

review.evidence: At Base block 47201583: yoUSD vault (0x0000000f2eB9f69274678c76222B35eEc7588a65) confirmed as TransparentUpgradeableProxy. ProxyAdmin = 0x12e81209d180ff0b3fbfbfe8fa9ffdb5990e1073 (confirmed via EIP-1967 admin slot). ProxyAdmin owner = TimelockController 0x38ce5e45d0f5d03e83863bb19b3b1a272c186f48 with 2-day minDelay (172800 seconds). Admin Safe (0x67b6...) holds PROPOSER_ROLE on the timelock. Safe confirmed 4-of-6, version 1.4.1+L2, no modules, zero guard via Safe API. Authority contract 0x9524e25079b1b04D904865704783A5aA0202d44D confirmed as the operational vault/strategy permission layer owned by the Safe.
unresolvedQuestions: The authority contract (0x9524e25079b1b04D904865704783A5aA0202d44D) internal role structure was not enumerated — confirm whether it holds any additional minting roles beyond strategy/protocol whitelisting, or whether minting is entirely deposit-driven with no privileged mint call.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: yoUSD is a USDC-denominated ERC-4626 reserve vault allocated across approved DeFi strategies rather than a borrower CDP.
